name: TherapyAppointment
short_description: Affordable mental health EHR and practice management for therapists and counselors with scheduling, billing, notes, and telehealth.
long_description: TherapyAppointment is a cloud-based practice management and EHR platform designed specifically for mental health therapists and counselors. Founded around 2006 in Indiana, TherapyAppointment targets solo practitioners and small group practices with an affordable, straightforward solution. The platform includes online scheduling with client self-booking, clinical documentation with progress note templates, insurance billing with clearinghouse connectivity, payment processing, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, a client portal, and secure messaging. TherapyAppointment offers outcome tracking with standardized assessments including PHQ-9 and GAD-7. The platform emphasizes simplicity and value, positioning itself as a cost-effective alternative to more feature-rich (and expensive) competitors. TherapyAppointment does not include e-prescribing, making it best suited for non-prescribing therapists and counselors rather than psychiatrists. The company offers straightforward per-clinician pricing without long-term contracts.
one_liner: The budget-friendly practice management solution for therapists and counselors.
best_for: Solo therapists seeking affordable practice management
Small counseling practices with straightforward needs
Non-prescribing clinicians needing basic EHR and billing
not_for: Large group practices with complex workflows

pricing.notes: Individual plan approximately $39-$49/month, group practice pricing scales per provider. 30-day free trial available. No long-term contracts required. Additional charges for credit card processing.
